scenes.chapter: HOOK (0:00)
scenes.visual: satellite push-in from space to the Persian Gulf, stop on the narrow strait
scenes.narration: Duniya ke naqshe pe ek jagah hai… sirf 39 kilometre chaudi. [pause] Aur 2026 mein, is ek jagah ne poori duniya ko hila diya.

scenes.chapter: HOOK (0:00)
scenes.visual: "2,00,00,000 barrel / din" ticking up, then "≈ 20% duniya ki khapat"
scenes.narration: Yahan se roz lagbhag do crore barrel tel guzarta tha. Yaani duniya ki kul petroleum khapat ka kareeb 20 percent.

scenes.chapter: HOOK (0:00)
scenes.visual: AI illustration: tanker on dark water, distant smoke (label "AI-generated illustration")
scenes.narration: 28 February 2026 ko, kuch hi ghanton mein, ye raasta lagbhag band ho gaya. Tel sau dollar ke paar. Hazaaron jahaz phans gaye. Aur kuch Hindustani sailors… kabhi ghar wapas nahi aaye.

scenes.chapter: HOOK (0:00)
scenes.visual: stickman leans forward, open-palm gesture
scenes.narration: Namaskar, aap dekh rahe hain AMRIT BORII. Aaj ki kahani hai Strait of Hormuz ki. Ek patli si samundari gali, jiske liye Portugal lada, Persia lada, America lada… aur aaj bhi jung jaari hai. Lekin sabse bada sawaal hai — India ka kya hoga? Iska jawab video ke end mein milega, aur wo jawab shayad aapko surprise karega.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 1 — 39 kilometre ka khel
scenes.visual: Persian Gulf, countries light up one by one with flags
scenes.narration: Pehle naqsha samajhte hain. Ye hai Persian Gulf — ek band thaili jaisa samundar. Iske kinare baithe hain Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, UAE… aur doosri taraf Iran.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 1 — 39 kilometre ka khel
scenes.visual: camera glides to the mouth; distance line Iran ↔ Musandam "≈ 39 km (21 nautical miles)"
scenes.narration: Is thaili ka sirf ek muh hai — Strait of Hormuz. Upar Iran. Neeche Oman ka ek chhota sa tukda, Musandam. Sabse patli jagah pe dono kinaron ke beech lagbhag 21 nautical mile ka faasla hai. Yaani kareeb 39 kilometre.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 1 — 39 kilometre ka khel
scenes.visual: top-down lanes: inbound lane, buffer, outbound lane, each labelled "~2 nautical miles"
scenes.narration: Lekin asli raasta isse bhi patla hai. Bade tankers ko gehra paani chahiye. Isliye yahan do lane bani hain — ek andar aane ki, ek bahar jaane ki. Har lane sirf lagbhag do nautical mile chaudi, aur beech mein do mile ka buffer.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 1 — 39 kilometre ka khel
scenes.visual: myth-buster card "MYTH: Hormuz Iran ka hai" → stamp "SACH"
scenes.narration: Aur ek baat jo bahut log galat samajhte hain. Ye shipping lanes Iran ke nahi, Oman ke paani se guzarti hain. Zyadatar desh maante hain ki yahan "transit passage" ka haq hai — yaani har desh ka jahaz bina roke guzar sakta hai. Lekin Iran ne samundari kanoon UNCLOS pe sign to kiya, ratify kabhi nahi kiya. Iran ka kehna hai ki ye haq sirf us treaty ke members ka hai. [pause] Dilchasp baat — America ne bhi UNCLOS ratify nahi kiya. Wo ise purane international customary law ka hissa maanta hai.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 1 — 39 kilometre ka khel
scenes.visual: bar: 84% → Asia; flags China, India, Japan, South Korea pop in
scenes.narration: Ab numbers dekhiye. US Energy Information Administration ke mutabik, 2024 mein yahan se roz lagbhag do crore barrel tel guzra. Isme se kareeb 84 percent Asia gaya — China, India, Japan aur South Korea.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 1 — 39 kilometre ka khel
scenes.visual: pipelines draw: Saudi East–West to Yanbu, UAE to Fujairah; counter "≈ 26 lakh barrel/din"
scenes.narration: Koi doosra raasta? Saudi aur UAE ke paas pipelines hain jo Hormuz ko bypass karti hain — Red Sea pe Yanbu tak, aur Fujairah tak. Lekin EIA ke hisaab se inme bas lagbhag 26 lakh barrel roz ki extra jagah hai. [pause] Do crore ke saamne… sirf 26 lakh.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 1 — 39 kilometre ka khel
scenes.visual: stickman points to screen-right map
scenes.narration: To ye 39 kilometre itne keemti bane kaise? Iska jawab 500 saal pehle shuru hota hai… jab ek Portuguese admiral yahan pahuncha.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 2 — Tel se pehle: Hormuz ka sultanate
scenes.visual: old-paper style trade routes: India ↔ Hormuz ↔ Persia ↔ Arabia ↔ East Africa
scenes.narration: Tel milne se sadiyon pehle bhi Hormuz duniya ka bazaar tha. Kingdom of Hormuz — ek chhota sa island, lekin India, Persia, Arab aur Africa ke beech ka sabse bada trading port. Moti, ghode, masale, kapda… sab yahin se guzarta tha.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 2 — Tel se pehle: Hormuz ka sultanate
scenes.visual: aged travel-journal page with ink marker circle on "Ormus"
scenes.narration: Marco Polo khud 1272 aur 1293 mein Hormuz se guzra tha.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 2 — Tel se pehle: Hormuz ka sultanate
scenes.visual: Portuguese route around Africa; three red circles: Aden, Hormuz, Malacca; base pin Goa
scenes.narration: Phir 1498 mein Vasco da Gama India pahuncha, aur Portugal ko ek baat samajh aa gayi. Indian Ocean ka trade control karna hai, to teen darwaze chahiye — Aden, Hormuz aur Malacca. Aur base hoga Goa.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 2 — Tel se pehle: Hormuz ka sultanate
scenes.visual: AI illustration: carracks off a fortified island (label "AI-generated illustration")
scenes.narration: 1507 mein Afonso de Albuquerque ne Hormuz pe hamla kiya. Pehli baar wo zyada der tik nahi paya. Lekin 1515 mein wo wapas aaya — aur is baar Hormuz pe Portugal ka pakka kabza ho gaya. Wahan ek mazboot qila bana, jiske khandahar aaj bhi Hormuz island pe khade hain.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 2 — Tel se pehle: Hormuz ka sultanate
scenes.visual: kinetic text "100+ saal · Portugal ki marzi"
scenes.narration: Agle sau saal se zyada, Gulf se nikalne wala bada trade Portugal ki marzi se chalta tha.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 2 — Tel se pehle: Hormuz ka sultanate
scenes.visual: Safavid Persia in green; five English ships slide in from the Arabian Sea
scenes.narration: Phir aaye Persia ke Shah Abbas. Unke paas fauj thi, lekin navy nahi. Aur navy thi… English East India Company ke paas. [pause] Haan — wahi company jo aage chalkar India pe raaj karne wali thi.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 2 — Tel se pehle: Hormuz ka sultanate
scenes.visual: ink flash → stamp "22 APRIL 1622"
scenes.narration: Deal hui. English jahazon ne samundar se golabari ki, Persian fauj ne zameen se ghera. 22 April 1622 — Hormuz se Portugal ka raaj khatam.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 2 — Tel se pehle: Hormuz ka sultanate
scenes.visual: pin moves from Hormuz island to mainland, label "Bandar Abbas"
scenes.narration: Shah Abbas trade ko island se hata kar mainland ke ek naye port pe le gaye. Uska naam pada — Bandar Abbas. Aaj wahi shehar Iran ki navy ka headquarters hai.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 2 — Tel se pehle: Hormuz ka sultanate
scenes.visual: stickman taps temple, "yaad rakhiye" gesture
scenes.narration: Ye pattern yaad rakhiye. Jo Hormuz control karta hai, wo trade control karta hai. 1622 mein ek company ne seekh liya ki ek chokepoint kitna keemti hota hai. Aur ye sabak 360 saal baad phir dohraya gaya.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 3 — Tanker War: jab Gulf jal utha
scenes.visual: Iran and Iraq, front line, oil terminals Kharg Island marked
scenes.narration: 1980. Iran aur Iraq ke beech jung shuru hoti hai — aath saal lambi jung. 1984 tak dono ne socha — dushman ko todna hai, to uska tel todo.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 3 — Tanker War: jab Gulf jal utha
scenes.visual: "451 jahaz" counter, red ship icons fill the Gulf
scenes.narration: Isse kehte hain Tanker War. 1984 se 1988 ke beech Gulf mein 451 jahazon pe hamla hua.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 3 — Tanker War: jab Gulf jal utha
scenes.visual: convoy line Kuwait → Hormuz with US flag icons; counter "127 convoy · 259 jahaz"
scenes.narration: Kuwait ne America se madad maangi. Kuwaiti tankers pe American jhanda lagaya gaya, aur US Navy ne unhe escort kiya. Operation Earnest Will — chaudah mahino mein 127 convoy, 259 jahaz.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 3 — Tanker War: jab Gulf jal utha
scenes.visual: AI illustration: frigate with hull damage near a sea mine (label "AI-generated illustration")
scenes.narration: 14 April 1988. American frigate USS Samuel B. Roberts ek Iranian mine se takraata hai. Chaar din baad America ka jawab aata hai — Operation Praying Mantis. Ek hi din mein Iran ke kai jangi jahaz aur do oil platforms tabah.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 3 — Tanker War: jab Gulf jal utha
scenes.visual: thin flight path Bandar Abbas → Dubai, fades to black; text "290"
scenes.narration: Aur phir 3 July 1988. Iran Air Flight 655 — Bandar Abbas se Dubai. USS Vincennes ne use galti se fighter jet samajh kar missile daag di. [pause] 290 log. Sab maare gaye. America ne ise ek galti bataya aur baad mein muavza bhi diya. Lekin Iran mein ye zakhm aaj bhi zinda hai.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 3 — Tanker War: jab Gulf jal utha
scenes.visual: stickman, slow nod
scenes.narration: Tanker War ne duniya ko ek cheez sikha di. Hormuz ko poori tarah band karna mushkil hai. Lekin use itna khatarnak bana dena ki koi guzarna hi na chahe… wo kahin zyada aasaan hai. [pause] 38 saal baad, bilkul yahi hua.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 4 — 28 February 2026: jab darwaza band hua
scenes.visual: date stamp "28.02.2026" with paper-tear reveal "Geneva: nuclear talks jaari"
scenes.narration: 28 February 2026. Geneva mein America aur Iran ke beech nuclear talks chal rahi thi. Usi beech America aur Israel ne Iran pe hamla kar diya.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 4 — 28 February 2026: jab darwaza band hua
scenes.visual: Iran with strike markers (generic, no casualty imagery)
scenes.narration: Pehle hi din Iran ke Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei maare gaye. Baad mein unke bete Mojtaba Khamenei naye Supreme Leader chune gaye.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 4 — 28 February 2026: jab darwaza band hua
scenes.visual: split screen: "America ka kehna" | "Iran ka kehna"
scenes.narration: America ka kehna tha — Iran ko nuclear hathiyar se rokna zaroori tha. Iran ka kehna tha — baat-cheet ke beech hamla seedhi aggression hai. Kai international law experts ne bhi is hamle ki legality pe sawaal uthaye.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 4 — 28 February 2026: jab darwaza band hua
scenes.visual: live-traffic dots in the strait vanish; counter "-70%"
scenes.narration: Iran ka jawab missiles aur drones mein aaya… aur Hormuz mein. Kuch hi ghanton mein IRGC ne radio pe jahazon ko chetavani di — koi nahi guzrega. Ship-tracking data mein traffic lagbhag 70 percent gir gaya.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 4 — 28 February 2026: jab darwaza band hua
scenes.visual: Brent line chart crossing $100 (8 Mar), peak label "~$126"
scenes.narration: 8 March. Brent crude chaar saal mein pehli baar sau dollar ke paar gaya. Aage chalkar ye lagbhag 126 dollar tak pahuncha. March 2026 mein tel ki keemat ne itihaas ki sabse badi monthly chhalaang lagayi.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 4 — 28 February 2026: jab darwaza band hua
scenes.visual: insurance document gets a red "CANCELLED" stamp
scenes.narration: Aur asli hathiyar missile nahi tha. Asli hathiyar tha — insurance. 5 March tak jahazon ka insurance cover wapas le liya gaya. Strait kagaz pe khula tha… lekin koi jahaz andar jaane ko taiyaar nahi tha.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 4 — 28 February 2026: jab darwaza band hua
scenes.visual: "≈ 2,000 jahaz · ≈ 20,000 seafarers phanse" (source: IMO)
scenes.narration: International Maritime Organization ke mutabik, April tak lagbhag do hazaar jahaz aur bees hazaar seafarers Gulf mein phanse hue the.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 4 — 28 February 2026: jab darwaza band hua
scenes.visual: Islamabad pin, dotted line to Washington and Tehran; then US Navy blockade line at Iranian ports
scenes.narration: 8 April ko Pakistan ki madhyasthata mein do hafte ka ceasefire hua. Lekin Islamabad talks fail ho gayi. Aur 13 April se America ne Iran ke ports ki naval blockade shuru kar di. [pause] Ab ek nahi… do blockade the.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 5 — Toll, mines aur toota hua samjhauta
scenes.visual: official-looking paper (clearly marked "illustration") titled "Persian Gulf Strait Authority"
scenes.narration: 5 May ko Iran ne ek naya idaara banaya — Persian Gulf Strait Authority. Iske hisaab se Hormuz se guzarne ke liye Iran se permit lena hoga… aur toll dena hoga.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 5 — Toll, mines aur toota hua samjhauta
scenes.visual: "Reportedly" tag on screen; ₹ → ¥ coin flip
scenes.narration: Shipping publication Lloyd's List ki reporting ke mutabik, ye toll Chinese yuan mein liya ja raha tha. Aur ek report ke mutabik, ek jahaz ne guzarne ke liye lagbhag do million dollar diye.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 5 — Toll, mines aur toota hua samjhauta
scenes.visual: split screen again: "US: Hormuz koi toll road nahi" | "Iran: ye security ki keemat hai"
scenes.narration: America ka kehna hai — Hormuz koi toll road nahi hai, aur jo jahaz Iran ko toll dega, US Navy use rokegi. Iran ka kehna hai — ye uski security aur nuksaan ki bharpai ka haq hai.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 5 — Toll, mines aur toota hua samjhauta
scenes.visual: timeline ribbon: 17 Jun "Islamabad Memorandum" → 8 Jul "truce toota" → 14 Jul "doosri blockade"
scenes.narration: June mein laga ki jung khatam ho gayi. Dono deshon ne Islamabad Memorandum sign kiya. Lekin 8 July ko truce toot gaya, jab commercial jahazon pe phir hamle hue. America ne Iran ke andar strikes kiye. Aur 14 July se doosri blockade shuru ho gayi.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 5 — Toll, mines aur toota hua samjhauta
scenes.visual: sonar sweep reveals mine icons; counter "100+"
scenes.narration: Phir aayi mines. August mein US officials ne bataya ki underwater drones ne strait mein sau se zyada suspected mines dhoondhi hain.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 5 — Toll, mines aur toota hua samjhauta
scenes.visual: stickman turns to camera, both hands open
scenes.narration: Ab aap soch rahe honge — ye to Middle East ka jhagda hai, hum pe kya asar? To ab baat karte hain us sawaal ki, jo maine shuru mein poocha tha.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 6 — India: sabse bada imtihaan
scenes.visual: India with tanker lines from the Gulf; half the lines glow red
scenes.narration: Shipping data company Kpler ke mutabik, 2026 ki shuruaat mein India ke crude imports ka lagbhag aadha hissa Hormuz se hokar aata tha.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 6 — India: sabse bada imtihaan
scenes.visual: dark memorial card, candle icon, no faces
scenes.narration: Aur keemat sirf paise mein nahi chukani padi. 1 March ko hi alag-alag jahazon pe teen Hindustani sailors ki jaan gayi. June mein Settebello naam ke tanker pe teen aur — reports ke mutabik ye hamla US blockade enforcement ke dauran hua. July mein aur bhi. Indian media ke hisaab se kam se kam saat Hindustani seafarers ne apni jaan gawaayi.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 6 — India: sabse bada imtihaan
scenes.visual: paper notice "DG Shipping — no deployment via Hormuz"
scenes.narration: India ne dono taraf apni baat rakhi — Iran se bhi protest kiya, America se bhi. July mein DG Shipping ne order diya: koi bhi Hindustani seafarer Hormuz wali voyage pe deploy nahi hoga.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 6 — India: sabse bada imtihaan
scenes.visual: Indian Navy ship icons in the Gulf of Oman escorting LPG tankers out
scenes.narration: Indian Navy ke warships Gulf of Oman mein utre, aur Hindustani LPG tankers ko escort karke surakshit bahar laaye.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 6 — India: sabse bada imtihaan
scenes.visual: world map: supply lines light up from Russia, USA, West Africa, Latin America; counter "43 desh"
scenes.narration: Aur yahan aata hai wo surprise. India ne chupchaap apna tel ka naksha badal diya. Government ke mutabik, March tak hi lagbhag 70 percent crude aise raston se aane laga jo Hormuz ko bypass karte hain. Russia se record khareed hui. June 2026 mein India ka crude import record 49 lakh barrel roz tak pahuncha. Aur November tak India lagbhag 43 deshon se tel le raha tha.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 6 — India: sabse bada imtihaan
scenes.visual: LPG cylinder icon fills to "≈ 90% via Hormuz"
scenes.narration: Lekin ek kamzori abhi bhi baaki hai — LPG. India ki LPG shipments ka lagbhag 90 percent aam taur pe Hormuz se hi aata hai. Matlab aapke ghar ka gas cylinder… seedha is 39 kilometre se juda hai.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 6 — India: sabse bada imtihaan
scenes.visual: stickman, calm, hands together
scenes.narration: To jawab ye hai. Hormuz band hone se India ruka nahi. Lekin India ko ye zaroor pata chal gaya ki uski asli kamzori kahan hai.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 7 — Aage kya?
scenes.visual: strait today: sparse traffic dots; side cards "7 shartein", Qatar pin
scenes.narration: Aaj, November 2026 mein, haal kya hai? UKMTO ke mutabik October mein bhi traffic pre-war se lagbhag 70 percent kam tha. Iran keh raha hai ki strait tab tak band rahega jab tak America uski saat shartein nahi maanta — military operations band ho, sanctions hatein, frozen assets lautaaye jaayein, aur blockade khatam ho. Qatar beech mein baat-cheet kara raha hai, aur nuclear inspection sabse bada atka hua mudda hai.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 7 — Aage kya?
scenes.visual: fast recap montage with ink flashes: 1515 Portugal → 1622 Persia + EIC → 1988 US convoys → 2026
scenes.narration: Portugal ne socha tha qila kaafi hai. Persia ne socha navy kiraye pe le lo. America ne 1988 mein socha convoy kaafi hain. Har baar sabak ek hi tha — Hormuz pe kabza karna aasaan hai… use chalana mushkil.

scenes.chapter: CHAPTER 7 — Aage kya?
scenes.visual: stickman, closing gesture, subscribe overlay
scenes.narration: 39 kilometre. 500 saal. Aur sawaal wahi — jo is gali ko control karega, kya wo duniya ki economy control karega? Ya duniya iske bina jeena seekh legi… jaise India seekh raha hai? Comment mein zaroor bataiye aapko kya lagta hai. Agar ye video kaam ki lagi ho to subscribe kijiye. Agli video mein ek aur chokepoint ki kahani — Bab al-Mandab. Milte hain agli kahani mein.
